name: Diagnostics
description:
Automatic LSP, linter and formatter feedback after Edit or Write. The plugin subscribes to the `tool.didInvoke` chain. It detects the diagnostic tools the project already has (tsgo, biome, oxlint, probed from node_modules/.bin + config files, never installed).

The plugin runs them on the newly written file and attaches structured findings plus a compact `<ma::agent::diagnostics>` note for the model. Type diagnostics use a persistent tsgo LSP (warm 2-3ms/edit) guarded by a circuit breaker. Format and lint spawn per call. By default, types and format are on, and lint is off. Configure via `plugins.diagnostics` in ~/.minimal-agent/config.jsonc, or disable with `plugins.diagnostics.enabled=false` or MINIMAL_AGENT_DIAGNOSTICS_DISABLED=1.
